desc: Parse INI-style configuration lines. Trim each line (remove leading and trailing whitespace) before looking at it. Skip a line that is then empty or starts with "#". A line starting with "[" is a section header: it must end with "]" and the text between the brackets, trimmed, must be non-empty; that trimmed text becomes the current section. Any other line is a setting: it must contain "="; the key is the text before the first "=", trimmed, and the value is everything after the first "=", trimmed (it may contain more "=" characters, and may be empty). The key must not be empty. Settings before any header belong to section "". Return the settings in order of first appearance; if a (section, key) pair appears again (even after switching to another section and back), replace its value but keep its original position. Stop at the first bad line with the error "line N: bad header", "line N: missing =" or "line N: empty key", where N is the 1-based line number.

decls.ts:
type Setting = { section: string; key: string; value: string };
type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
